0.name: R
0.text: Yes, yes, that is quite charming, isn’t it?

1.name: R
1.text: Even though it won’t be near my mouth, it certainly satisfies me.

2.name: R
2.text: Now, let’s get to the good stuff.

4.name: R
4.text: Fetishes, scientifically paraphilias, are something innate to a person.

5.name: R
5.text: Morals and predisposed notions of common sense may prevent one from exploring their own internal senses, of course.

6.name: R
6.text: But it is undeniable that everyone has certain tastes.

8.name: R
8.text: There are a lot of them, you know?

9.name: R
9.text: Can I ask if you’ve really stopped talking to your parents?

10.name: R
10.text: From the tame to the utterly absurd, each of them catalogued.

11.name: R
11.text: Just like amychophilia pertains to the arousal from scratching or being scratched by someone...

12.name: R
12.text: Homilophilia dictates the arousal from sermons or religious preachings.

13.name: R
13.text: Could you imagine that? A son of god with too much passion in their devotion? How quaint!

15.name: R
15.text: Those types of things can really tell a lot about a person.

16.name: R
16.text: And someone may wonder, then, how innate are they?

17.name: R
17.text: A biological factor? An ambience factor? Genetics?

18.name: R
18.text: And how is it that some are born with such criminal tendencies in something as far from the survival factor as the concept of pleasure?

19.name: R
19.text: If there is a God, they must be a twisted being indeed, hm?

20.name: R
20.text: Or they may simply be rolling dice to produce us, who knows.

21.name: M
21.text: ...Can I help you with anything else?

22.name: R
22.text: That would be all, thank you very much.

23.name: R
23.text: I’ll be sure to come back tomorrow, it looks to me like some part of you quite enjoyed that little talk.
